attributes.name: Pirate Entertainments
attributes.powers:
The difficulty to defeat this barrier is increased by the adventure deck number of the current scenario, if any.

Each character at your location encounters this barrier. Each character that does not defeat this barrier takes 2 Combat damage that may not be reduced. If any character defeats this barrier, it is defeated; the character with the highest result (you choose in case of a tie) may add a plunder card from the box to his hand.
